project_description:
The consentmanager.net CMP (Consent Management Provider) allows your to easily collect consent from your website visitors in order to become GDPR and CCPA compliant.

 Back to top 

 How does it work? 
 Our CMP solution is very simple to integrate: Simply login to your consentmanager.net account, set up your website(s), create the code and paste it into your website module settings page ( /admin/config/services/consent-manager ). Our platform will automatically start gathering consent from your visitors. As soon as the code is on your website, advertisers will have access to the consent data via the open-source API defined by the IAB.

 In addition, you will get detailed reports which show you how your visitors are behaving with the consent layer, how many consents you get, and how you can optimize your strategies in order to obtain higher rates of consent.

 Back to top 

 Warning regarding 2.x and 7.x-2.x versions 
 These versions are not compatible with 1.x and 7.x-1.x versions. After updating, you need to change the configuration of the module on this page /admin/config/services/consent-manager .
